en: the beleaguered Russian proletariat
context: Then the beleaguered Russian proletariat would receive the political and material help of advanced societies to placate the Russian peasantry and ensure the survival of the workers’ State.
meaning: 被围困、四面受敌的
current_zh: 只有到那时，陷于包围中的俄国无产阶级才可能得到先进社会的政治援助和物质援助
suggest: 四面受困的俄国无产阶级
note: beleaguered 本义被围城；“四面受困”贴切。“孤立无援”偏重无援，作备选。

en: break out of the backward Russian ghetto
context: in this way, Russia’s working class could escape, break out of the backward Russian ghetto and the disciplines backwardness threatened to impose on their ambitions to freedom.
meaning: 冲出落后俄国这块与世隔绝的围地
current_zh: 只有这样，俄国工人阶级才可能摆脱俄国这个落后囚笼，摆脱落后对自由抱负所强加的纪律
suggest: 冲出落后俄国这座牢笼
alt: 冲出落后俄国这座孤城
note: ghetto 是隔离区，强调被隔绝；“牢笼/囚笼”可用。不用“围城”（钱锺书书名联想）。现译漏了 threatened to impose（落后“可能强加”的纪律），宜补。

en: The régime stumbled between domestic needs … and demands from abroad
context: The régime stumbled between domestic needs of great urgency—for grain, for the rehabilitation and expansion of industry, for modern armed forces—and demands from abroad, for help in Germany, Bulgaria, China and Britain.
meaning: 在国内急需和国外求援两头之间跌跌撞撞、顾此失彼
current_zh: 政权在紧迫的国内需要与国外求援之间进退失据
note: 现译“进退失据”可用；stumbled between 更像两头奔忙，“顾此失彼”更贴。

en: to end the stalemate
context: It was the peculiar historical task of Stalin and his followers to end the stalemate
meaning: 结束僵持不下的局面（棋局和局）
current_zh: 斯大林及其追随者的特殊历史任务，就在于结束这种僵局
note: 现译可用；“打破僵局”更通行。

en: driving Britain and France into the arms of Nazi Germany
context: In Spain, the civil war need not have been lost if Stalin had not been so obsessed with driving Britain and France into the arms of Nazi Germany.
meaning: 把英法推进纳粹德国的怀抱
current_zh: 西班牙内战本来也不必以失败告终，可斯大林一心害怕把英国和法国推到纳粹德国一边，结果葬送了这种可能
note: 习语本身好译。但字面是 obsessed with driving（一心要把英法推过去），现译理解为“一心害怕”，合史实（斯大林怕西班牙革命吓跑英法），却与字面相反，见汇报；“结果葬送了这种可能”是增译。

en: smothered in the Popular Front
context: In France, the potential independent force that was smothered in the Popular Front was another basis for breaking Russia’s isolation.
meaning: 被人民阵线捂死、扼杀
current_zh: 在法国，本来也存在一股足以打破俄国孤立的潜在独立力量，可它后来被人民阵线窒息了
note: “被……窒息了”语法别扭；“扼杀”通行。

en: flattened out all choice
context: history now seemed to have a “necessary” character that flattened out all choice
meaning: 把一切选择都碾平、抹掉
current_zh: 历史此时仿佛获得了一种“必然性”，它抹平了一切其他选择
note: 现译可用；“其他”为增字。

en: hardened cadres
context: Its ranks of hardened cadres had fought, not to build “national socialism”, but to win a world.
meaning: 久经锤炼、身经百战的干部队伍
current_zh: 党内那批久经考验的干部
note: “久经考验”是中共常用褒义套语，带官方色彩；“身经百战”更中性。两者都不违原意。

en: to win a world
context: Its ranks of hardened cadres had fought, not to build “national socialism”, but to win a world.
meaning: 化用《共产党宣言》结尾“他们获得的将是整个世界”
current_zh: 原先奋斗的目标并不是建设“民族社会主义”，而是争取整个世界
suggest: 而是为了赢得整个世界
alt: 而是为了夺取整个世界
note: 典故，宜贴近《宣言》中译，可在完整版加注。“夺取”稍偏军事。

en: to tilt the balance
context: Waves of new recruits flowed into the party in the 1920s to tilt the balance.
meaning: 让天平倾斜，改变党内新老力量对比
current_zh: 1920 年代一波又一波新成员涌入党内，正是为了改变力量平衡
note: “改变力量平衡”是翻译腔，改“力量对比”；“正是为了”略增强目的性，可改“以改变……”。

en: swept away all the old social forces
context: because it had, in 1917, swept away all the old social forces of the past phase of Russian national development
meaning: 一扫而空
current_zh: 恰恰是因为它在 1917 年已经扫除了俄国民族发展旧阶段中的那些旧社会力量
note: 现译可用；“一扫而空”更有力，与 all 相合。

en: tied politically to the needs of accumulation
context: For more than a generation, the most advanced sections of the working class in the advanced countries were tied politically to the needs of accumulation in the Soviet Union
meaning: 在政治上被绑在苏联积累的需要上
current_zh: 在政治上都被绑在苏联积累的需要上
suggest: 在政治上被绑在苏联积累的需要上
alt: 被绑上苏联积累的战车
note: 现译可用；“绑上战车”是常见说法，但多出“战车”意象，只作备选。

en: bend each workers’ movement it controlled to the needs of its foreign policy
context: It permitted the Russian State to bend each workers’ movement it controlled to the needs of its foreign policy, to the territorial defence of the Soviet Union as a national power.
meaning: 强行扭转，使之屈从
current_zh: 它使俄国国家可以把自己所控制的每一个工人运动，都扭向苏联外交政策的需要
suggest: 都拧过来服从苏联外交政策的需要
alt: 都扳到苏联外交政策的轨道上
note: “扭向需要”搭配别扭；bend 意为使之屈从，“拧过来服从”保留用力扭转的动作。

en: smitten by a crisis some saw as fatal
context: In the 1930s when the whole advanced bloc was smitten by a crisis some saw as fatal
meaning: 遭到一场有人认为是致命的危机重创
current_zh: 在整个先进资本主义集团都被世界危机重击、很多人觉得它们会完蛋的 1930 年代
suggest: 整个先进集团遭到一场有人以为会要命的危机重创
alt: 遭受一场被一些人视为致命的危机
note: some saw → 现译“很多人”略夸大；“完蛋”太口语。避免“在劫难逃”（宿命色彩）。

en: lob missiles into space
context: it transformed Russia from a backward peasant society, from the muzhik world, to an advanced industrial power that could lob missiles into space and challenge the imperialists of the world
meaning: 把导弹（火箭）轻巧地抛上太空，略带调侃
current_zh: 变成一个能把导弹送上天空、能向世界帝国主义提出挑战的先进工业强国
alt: 能随手把导弹抛上太空
note: space 是太空不是天空；lob 的轻巧调侃意味难对等，平实译即可，备选可试。

en: manifold links with foreign capital
context: It was anti-capitalist because—to undertake accumulation—it utilized the State, not private businessmen with their manifold links with foreign capital.
meaning: 与外国资本有多方面的牵连
current_zh: 而不是那些同外国资本有千丝万缕联系的私人商人
note: 现译已用成语，manifold links 正是千丝万缕，保留。

en: to draw a sharp line between
context: It was in this light that Marx warned workers in Germany, still at that time a backward country, to draw a sharp line between their class interests and those of the “democratic petite bourgeoisie”.
meaning: 清清楚楚地划出界线
current_zh: 马克思正是在这个意义上提醒德国工人，必须把自己的阶级利益同“民主的小资产阶级”的利益清楚区分开来
note: draw a sharp line 正是“划清界限”，中文政治语汇通行，不多出判断。

en: remained wedded to private property
context: for Marx, the “democratic petty bourgeoisie” remained wedded to private property, even if they might make temporary concessions ... The Chinese Communists were not at all wedded to the private ownership of the means of production.
meaning: 死守、离不开私有财产（婚姻比喻）
current_zh: 因为对马克思来说，“民主的小资产阶级”始终依附于私有财产。……中国共产党则完全不受生产资料私有制的束缚。
suggest: 始终死抱着私有财产不放……中国共产党对生产资料私有制毫无眷恋
alt: 离不开私有财产……丝毫不恋栈私有制
note: 现译两处译法不一致，且“不受……束缚”意思偏了（wedded 是依恋、离不开，不是被束缚）。“死抱着不放”略带贬，符合马克思对小资产阶级的态度。

en: the strongholds of the old labour movement
context: most industrial countries have witnessed a relative decline in the proportion of the workforce in the strongholds of the old labour movement.
meaning: 老工人运动的大本营（重工业、矿业等）
current_zh: 二战以来，在多数工业国家中，旧工运堡垒所占的劳动力比例实际上都在相对下降
note: “堡垒”可用；“大本营/重镇”更自然。

en: was refracted into a much narrower contest
context: The historical clash which filled the minds of the Left, between the nationalist private capitalists and the internationalist workers, was refracted into a much narrower contest
meaning: 像光线折射一样变了形，成了一场窄得多的较量
current_zh: 此时，它却折射为一种狭窄得多的对抗
suggest: 折射成一场窄得多的较量
note: 现译保留折射意象，可用。另：filled the minds of 现译“念念不忘”略偏（是“满脑子想的”），可改“左派满脑子想的”。

en: loomed larger than talk of
context: The struggle to establish an independent State, to exclude foreigners from the competition for jobs in the civil service, loomed larger than talk of the small working classes emancipating the majority.
meaning: 比“小小的工人阶级解放多数人”这种说法显得更要紧
current_zh: 这样的目标显得比让小小的工人阶级去解放多数人民要重要得多
suggest: 远比“小小的工人阶级解放多数人”那套说法来得要紧
note: 现译漏了 talk of（只是说说而已），轻蔑口气丢失；“得多”是增强。

en: Thus it mortgaged its future power.
context: It was obliged to make concessions to entrenched interests, land, capital and small business, to prevent revolution. Thus it mortgaged its future power.
meaning: 以未来的权力作抵押，换取眼前不发生革命
current_zh: 为了避免革命，它只得向土地、资本和小企业的既得利益让步，预先拿未来的权力作了抵押
suggest: 这等于把自己未来的权力抵押了出去
note: “寅吃卯粮”是中国干支意象，且义为预支收入，不完全对；场景在亚非多国，不推荐，仅列备选。

en: expel and keep at bay foreign powers
context: The drive to “emancipate the State” and thereby expel and keep at bay foreign powers (primarily the British)
meaning: 赶走并挡在外面，不让靠近
current_zh: 其目的在于驱逐并挡住外国势力，主要是英国
suggest: 把外国势力赶出去，挡在门外
note: keep at bay 是“不让近身”，“挡在门外”对应。

en: closed in on the Egyptian economy
context: before the combined effects of the war with Israel and the contracting world opportunities for accumulation closed in on the Egyptian economy.
meaning: 四面合拢，把埃及经济困住
current_zh: 最终把埃及经济牢牢困住
note: 现译可用。

en: The “switching of the points” of history
context: The “switching of the points” of history from the aspirations of 1917 to those of 1789 (as reshaped by capitalism in the twentieth century) afflicted the Communist party
meaning: 铁路扳道岔：历史从1917年的轨道被扳到1789年的轨道上
current_zh: 历史转动了“道岔”，从 1917 年的理想转向 1789 年的理想
note: “扳道岔”是中文铁路的惯用动宾搭配，比“转动道岔”自然。

en: wrecked the party, uprooting it
context: The contradiction between the interests of the new Russian ruling class and those of the Chinese working class wrecked the party, uprooting it from the traditions of the October revolution.
meaning: 毁掉了这个党，把它从十月革命传统中连根拔起
current_zh: 直接摧毁了这个党，把它从十月革命传统中连根拔起
note: 现译已贴切。

en: encumbered with the interests of an urban working-class movement
context: The task of the partisans would have been insupportable if they had been encumbered with the interests of an urban working-class movement.
meaning: 背着城市工人运动的利益这个包袱
current_zh: 若这个党始终背负着一个城市工人运动的利益，那些游击队员根本不可能承受后来的生存任务。
suggest: 游击队要是背上城市工人运动的利益这个包袱，他们的任务就重得担不动了
note: 现译把主语从 partisans 换成“这个党”，又加了“后来的生存任务”，宜回到原文结构；encumbered 是“负重、拖累”，“包袱”贴切。

en: The régime went into reverse
context: The régime went into reverse, permitting the reappearance of the “rich peasant” economy, the old unregenerate small-holder.
meaning: 政策掉头往回走
current_zh: 政权于是倒退
note: 不用“开倒车”：中文“开倒车”指倒行逆施，贬义重，而此处是被迫退让。

en: the shifts and zigzags of policy
context: Throughout the shifts and zigzags of policy as the régime tried to propel China towards industrialization, none of the factions of the party challenged the need for rapid accumulation.
meaning: 政策的转向和来回摇摆
current_zh: 政权推动中国工业化的过程中，政策虽几经转折
note: zigzags 有左右来回之意，“左右摇摆”贴近，但在中共语汇里会被读成路线评价，故作备选；求稳用“几经反复”。

en: the peasant’s old nag of Chiang Kai-shek
context: no doubt they had in mind Stalin’s wish to exploit the peasant’s old nag of Chiang Kai-shek—cf. above, Chapter 2 (5).
meaning: 引斯大林1927年的比喻：蒋介石像农民还用得着的老马
current_zh: 他们心里无疑想着斯大林希望利用蒋介石这匹“农民的老驽马”
suggest: 利用蒋介石这匹农民的老马
note: 须与第1章斯大林引文统一：第1章现译把 old worn-out jade 译成“年老色衰的妓女”，而 jade 在此是老马（斯大林原话说的是农民的老马），与本注“老驽马”不一致，见汇报。
